svg.title: Recurrent syngas forecasting architecture
svg.desc: A window of 30 one-second observations ends at forecast origin t. Each row in time contains 11 reactor signals and four measured gas concentrations. A single RNN, LSTM, or GRU layer with 64 hidden units encodes the window. The final state enters a linear head with four outputs for CO, CO2, CH4, and H2. A separate model is trained for each lead time of 1, 3, 5, or 10 seconds.
svg.text: Waste-mask gasification in a fluidized bed
